overview: This item delivers a minimal but realistic example showing a behavior tree implemented as a Jido strategy, using the newly defined effects and signals. The example should demonstrate how to define a tree (including composites, decorators, and leaf tasks), how the strategy ticks the tree over time, and how side effects are expressed via Jido effects rather than direct IO. It should be small enough to be easily read yet rich enough to illustrate best practices. The example should include test coverage and a short narrative walkthrough explaining the structure of the tree, how control flows through it, and how signals are emitted during execution. It should be wired into the existing Jido dev/test harness so contributors can run and inspect behavior. This serves as the canonical hello world for behavior-tree-as-strategy.
title: Create example: behavior tree as Jido strategy
